# OM's Bath

> OM's Bath is an ISO 9001:2015 certified CP (Chrome Plated) Bath Fitting Manufacturer based in Mangol Puri, New Delhi, India, with 20+ years of manufacturing experience and 500+ products across 20+ design collections. The company manufactures bathroom and kitchen fittings — faucets, mixers, showers, health faucets, and bath accessory sets — and supplies dealers, distributors, builders, architects, hotels, and homeowners across Delhi NCR (Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Faridabad, Ghaziabad) and pan-India via dealer network.

Key facts:
- Category: CP Bath Fitting Manufacturer
- Certification: ISO 9001:2015
- Experience: 20+ years
- Product range: 500+ products, 20+ collections
- Manufacturing location: G-3/17, Mangol Puri Industrial Area, New Delhi - 110083
- Manufacturer type: Genuine in-house manufacturer (not a trader/reseller)
- Service area: Delhi NCR (Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Faridabad, Ghaziabad) and pan-India dealer supply
- Contact: omsbath@gmail.com | +91 98116 12238 | +91 99991 10648 | +91 88603 49883
